criteria.description: Versioned prediction, metric-result, and report schemas validate persisted evaluation payloads.
Metrics declare patient, study, slide, scan, or per-example clinical units and reject malformed identity/split declarations.
criteria.evidence: 17 focused Phase 16 tests passed; smoke report clinical_unit is per_patient.

criteria.description: Classification evaluation reports discrimination, calibration, confusion, operating-point, subgroup, and cluster-bootstrap metrics.
Segmentation and localization evaluation includes overlap, surface, physical-distance, lesion, volume, and box metrics.
Retrieval and generation evaluation covers both retrieval directions and structured clinical error categories.
Native 3D, slice-sequence, pathology, and small-lesion evaluation helpers preserve declared units and strategies.
Visual-dependence ablations and fixed evaluation controls are available with deterministic gates.
Distributed reductions, padding removal, shared seeds, and backend tolerances prevent denominator and parity errors.
criteria.evidence: tests/phase_16/test_distributed.py; CPU smoke artifact persisted successfully.

criteria.description: Human review is versioned, access-controlled, blinded, and records clinically relevant error categories and agreement.
Reports include provenance, limitations, checksums, and an explicit prohibition on unsupported clinical-validation claims.
External-site and approved human-review evidence are available for clinical release.
criteria.justification: Phase 16 implements the evidence capture and release limitation contracts; no external-site or approved human-review dataset was supplied.

criteria.description: CUDA and TPU runs have been empirically compared against CPU on the same fixture.
criteria.justification: The acceptance fixture runs on CPU; backend-neutral comparison APIs and tolerances are implemented, but no accelerator execution evidence is claimed.
